## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 441 captures during May 2026. This figure provides the reported measure of activity for the month and forms the basis for the image-quality and grading results set out below. The activity report records the number of captures completed at the site without adding other measures or comparisons.

## Image quality

There were 33 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 7.5. This rate is reported alongside the ungradable count to provide a clear view of image quality during May 2026. Together, the figures identify the volume of captures that could not be graded and the corresponding reported rate for the site.

## Grading

A total of 121 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2. This provides the reported summary of grading outcomes and turnaround for West Gate Eye Clinic during May 2026. The activity, image-quality, and grading measures should be read together as the site’s monthly operational results.
